primary_source.title: Verbalizable Representations Form a Global Workspace in Language Models

records.model_or_task_scope: layer-wise map averaged over 1,000 pretraining-like prompts
records.control: comparison framing against logit and tuned lenses
records.reported_result: A downstream Jacobian transports intermediate state into final-layer vocabulary coordinates.
records.reviewer_assessment: Well specified but first-order and average-context.
records.limitation: Exact fitting corpus and production model artifacts are not public.

records.intervention: swap or inject token-aligned concept directions
records.reported_result: Changing selected directions changes later reported concepts.
records.source_locator: Primary paper: verbal report and directed modulation
records.reviewer_assessment: Supports causal reportability for tested token-aligned concepts.
records.limitation: Concept coverage and intervention success are incomplete.

records.model_or_task_scope: 50 prompts across Haiku 4.5, Sonnet 4.5, and Opus 4.5
records.reported_result: Target answer reached top rank in 54%, 70%, and 70% of trials respectively.
records.reviewer_assessment: Evidence that selected unspoken intermediates causally affect answers.
records.limitation: Narrow synthetic tasks and proprietary checkpoints.

records.intervention: swap J-space or non-J-space probe component
records.reported_result: Answer flips were 61% for J-space, 28% for non-J-space, and 6% for non-J-space with clamping.
records.reviewer_assessment: One of the strongest causal mediation results in the paper.

records.intervention: swap argument directions at standard or double strength
records.reviewer_assessment: Shows partial reuse, not universal semantic-variable behavior.
records.limitation: Success depends on concept and workspace loading.

records.model_or_task_scope: 14-task ablation battery plus language and line-wrap studies
records.control: protected top-output tokens and comparison across task types
records.reported_result: Several flexible tasks degraded more than shallow or automatic tasks.
records.source_locator: Primary paper: selectivity and automatic processing
records.reviewer_assessment: Supports a selective interface and establishes important bypass behavior.
records.limitation: Author-selected task taxonomy may not predict new workloads.

records.intervention: sparse decomposition and matched random controls
records.reported_result: Median occupancy was near 25 directions and excess variance remained below 10%.
records.reviewer_assessment: Supports limited capacity while showing that causal importance is not variance dominance.
records.limitation: Active token count does not equal independent concept count.

records.intervention: ablate top 1% of selected attention heads
records.reported_result: Top-25 readout recall was 0.67 versus 0.86 under the random-head control.
records.reviewer_assessment: Supports privileged propagation of J-space-aligned directions.
records.limitation: Does not establish a recurrent biological workspace architecture.

records.reported_result: Explicit recognition fell from 71% to 3%; blackmail changed from 0/180 to 13/180.
records.reviewer_assessment: Identifies one causal contributor to behavior, not complete intent or alignment.
records.limitation: Selected organization-authored case with no calibrated detector metrics.

records.model_or_task_scope: 10,000 training contexts; 27-case fabrication and 100-scenario deception evaluations
records.intervention: reflection-only fine-tuning and targeted direction ablation
records.reported_result: Reported dishonesty changed from 0.25 to 0.07 and deception from 0.38 to 0.05.
records.reviewer_assessment: Suggests representational mediation of a bounded post-training effect.
records.limitation: LLM grading, one model family, organization-specific constitution, and no external replication.
